name: yandex-webmaster
description: Yandex Webmaster via the local mcp-yandex-webmaster npm server: site diagnostics, indexing, search queries, sitemaps, external links, recrawl. Sign in with Yandex right in the chat; a ready-made token is optional (for CI). Requires Node.js 20+.

token.title: Yandex Webmaster OAuth token (optional)
token.description: Leave empty to sign in with Yandex from the chat ("connect Yandex Webmaster"). Set only for CI or headless setups.

host_id.title: Default site host_id (optional)
host_id.description: For example https:example.com:443; leave empty to pick a site from list_sites
